domain_facts_captured.verification_status: DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE (assistant cutoff Jan 2026) — researcher must confirm each against current SAP sources before the writer states it. Clean core is a stable, well-documented SAP concept, but specific dimension names and ECC dates have shifted historically.
domain_facts_captured.definition: Clean core is the principle of keeping the SAP S/4HANA digital core as standard, cloud-compliant, and upgrade-safe as possible — moving customizations and extensions OUT of the core (typically to SAP BTP) instead of modifying the standard system, so the system stays easy to upgrade and ready for the cloud.
clean_core_dimensions_sap_framing: Extensions (use released extensibility — in-app/key-user + side-by-side on BTP — not core modifications)
Integrations (use released/public APIs and standard integration tech, not point-to-point hacks)
Business processes (adopt standard best-practice processes where possible)
Operations / governance (monitor and govern customization over time — 'clean-core maturity')

extensibility_model.in_app_key_user: Configure/extend within S/4HANA using released, upgrade-safe in-app (key-user) extensibility tools.
extensibility_model.side_by_side_btp: Build apps/extensions on SAP BTP alongside the core, connected via released APIs — the core stays untouched.
extensibility_model.abap_cloud: ABAP Cloud is the modern, restricted, upgrade-stable ABAP development model for clean-core-compliant custom code (released objects/APIs only).

why_it_matters: Upgrade speed/cost: a clean core makes S/4HANA upgrades faster and cheaper because there are no core modifications to re-test and re-fit.
Cloud readiness: public-cloud S/4HANA only permits released extensibility, so clean core is effectively a prerequisite for cloud ERP and a smoother RISE/GROW journey.
Technical-debt control: heavy legacy custom code (classic 'Z' modifications) is the #1 source of migration cost and risk; clean core is the discipline that prevents it from re-accumulating.
Continuous innovation: staying standard lets a company consume new SAP capabilities (incl. AI/Joule-class features) as they ship, rather than being frozen on a modified release.
domain_facts_captured.ecc_deadline_context: SAP ERP/ECC end of mainstream maintenance is widely cited as 2027, with extended/optional maintenance to 2030 (commonly referenced; researcher to confirm current SAP guidance — these dates have shifted historically). Clean core is what makes the move to S/4HANA Cloud before that deadline less painful.
domain_facts_captured.tie_in_clusters: Strong topical bridge to (1) ERP migration to the cloud (#1 — clean core enables a smoother cloud migration / RISE) and (2) Low-Code Platform (SAP Build / BTP side-by-side extensions are HOW you keep the core clean). Linking up to clean core reinforces the #1 ERP-migration asset.
